chapter.v:
Why are
the nations plotting rebellion? The peoples devise schemes, but they're pointless.

The kings
of the world prepare to attack, and the rulers conspire together against the Lord and his anointed one, saying,

“Let's break
the chains and throw away the cords that bind us.”

But the
one who sits enthroned in heaven laughs. The Lord mocks them.

He will
thunder at them, and terrify them in his fury, saying,

“It is
I who placed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.”

“I will
proclaim the Lord's decree,” says the king. “He told me, ‘You are my son. Today I have become your father.

Ask me,
and I will give you the nations as your possessions—the whole earth will belong to you.

You will
break them with a rod of iron, smashing them like pottery.’”

So then
you kings, be wise! Be warned, you rulers of the world!

Serve the
Lord in reverence, celebrate with trembling!

Submit to
his son so that he will not become angry and you die suddenly. His anger flares up quickly, but how happy are all those who go to him for protection.
